rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',
    fa.STREET_NUMBER,
    fa.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
    fa.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
    fa.STREET_NAME,
    fa.STREET_SUFFIX,
    fa.POST_DIRECTIONAL
  )) AS building_street_address,
  fa.CITY AS city,
  fa.STATE AS state,
  fa.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code
FROM fclt_organization_hist oh
JOIN fclt_organization o
  ON oh.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
-- find building via space_unit if available
LEFT JOIN space_unit s
  ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
-- join building directly by building key; also attempt match by building number to space_unit/SERVICE code if building_key absent
LEFT JOIN fclt_building b
  ON (s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY IS NOT NULL AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY)
   OR (s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE)
   OR b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
   OR b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fa
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE LOWER(oh.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
  AND fa.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  -- prefer current/most recent address if multiple: choose the address with max WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE per building
  AND fa.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = (
    SELECT MAX(fa2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE)
    FROM fclt_building_address fa2
    WHERE fa2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
      AND fa2.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  )
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.

  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activity_title,
  s.SESSION_LOCATION AS location,
  STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS term_start_date,
  p.PERSON_NAME AS supervisor_name
FROM iap_subject_detail d
JOIN iap_subject_session s
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN iap_subject_person p
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY

  AND p.PERSON_ROLE = 'Activity leader'
  AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL
  AND s.SESSION_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
  AND s.SESSION_DATE IS NOT NULL
  AND p.PERSON_NAME IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY term_start_date ASC

rows.question: What is the room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of Professor Summer Haynes's office?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH person AS (
  SELECT MIT_ID, FULL_NAME, OFFICE_LOCATION
  FROM se_person
  WHERE FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
),
room_match AS (
  SELECT
    r.ROOM AS room,
    r.FLOOR AS floor,
    r.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    r.SPACE_ID
  FROM fac_rooms r
  JOIN person p
    ON p.OFFICE_LOCATION = CONCAT(r.BUILDING_KEY, ' ', r.ROOM)
     OR p.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.ROOM
     OR p.OFFICE_LOCATION = r.SPACE_ID
),
building_address AS (
  SELECT
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    TRIM(CONCAT(
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_NUMBER,''), 
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER <> '' AND COALESCE(fba.STREET_NAME,'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_NAME,''),
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_SUFFIX <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba.STREET_SUFFIX,''),
      CASE WHEN fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL,'')
    )) AS building_street_address,
    fba.CITY AS city,
    fba.STATE AS state,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code
  FROM fac_building b
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
    AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  UNION
  SELECT
    fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    TRIM(CONCAT(
      COALESCE(fba2.STREET_NUMBER,''), 
      CASE WHEN fba2.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fba2.STREET_NUMBER <> '' AND COALESCE(fba2.STREET_NAME,'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba2.STREET_NAME,''),
      CASE WHEN fba2.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba2.STREET_SUFFIX <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba2.STREET_SUFFIX,''),
      CASE WHEN fba2.POST_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba2.POST_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(fba2.POST_DIRECTIONAL,'')
    )) AS building_street_address,
    fba2.CITY AS city,
    fba2.STATE AS state,
    fba2.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code
  FROM fclt_building fb
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fba2
    ON fba2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
    AND fba2.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
matched AS (
  SELECT
    rm.room,
    rm.floor,
    rm.building_key,
    ba.building_street_address,
    ba.city,
    ba.state,
    ba.postal_code
  FROM room_match rm
  LEFT JOIN building_address ba
    ON ba.building_key = rm.building_key
)
SELECT
  IFNULL(room,'') AS room,
  IFNULL(floor,'') AS floor,
  IFNULL(building_key,'') AS building_key,
  IFNULL(building_street_address,'') AS building_street_address,
  IFNULL(city,'') AS city,
  IFNULL(state,'') AS state,
  IFNULL(postal_code,'') AS postal_code
FROM matched
LIMIT 1

rows.question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.

SELECT
  so.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  COALESCE(fr.ROOM, fclt.ROOM, so.MEET_PLACE) AS room,
  COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, fclt.FLOOR, fclt_rooms.FLOOR) AS floor,
  COALESCE(fr.BUILDING_KEY, fclt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fclt_rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_key,
  fba.STREET_NAME AS building_street_address,
  fba.CITY AS city,
  fba.STATE AS state,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
  TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN so.IS_LECTURE_SECTION IN ('Y','1') THEN 'Lecture,' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN so.IS_LAB_SECTION IN ('Y','1') THEN 'Lab,' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN so.IS_RECITATION_SECTION IN ('Y','1') THEN 'Recitation,' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN so.IS_DESIGN_SECTION IN ('Y','1') THEN 'Design,' ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN ss_term.TERM_DURATION IS NOT NULL AND ss_term.TERM_DURATION <> '' THEN CONCAT(ss_term.TERM_DURATION, ',') ELSE '' END
  )) AS formats,
  COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, tip.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lib.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students
FROM subject_offered so
LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
  ON so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN subject_summary ss
  ON so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
-- alias specifically to pull TERM_DURATION (ensure defined before use in SELECT)
LEFT JOIN subject_summary ss_term
  ON so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = ss_term.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN subject_selector ssel
  ON so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = ssel.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered tip
  ON so.TERM_CODE = tip.TERM_CODE
  AND so.SUBJECT_ID = tip.SUBJECT_ID
  AND COALESCE(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,'') = COALESCE(tip.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,'')
LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lib
  ON so.TERM_CODE = lib.TERM_CODE
  AND so.SUBJECT_ID = lib.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
  ON fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE OR fr.ROOM = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fclt
  ON fclt.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE OR fclt.ROOM = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms_hist fclt_rooms
  ON fclt_rooms.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE OR fclt_rooms.ROOM = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
  ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = COALESCE(fr.BUILDING_KEY, fclt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fclt_rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
WHERE COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, tip.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lib.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 300
GROUP BY
  so.TERM_CODE,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  room,
  floor,
  building_key,
  fba.STREET_NAME,
  fba.CITY,
  fba.STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE,
  formats,
  enrolled_students

rows.question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total costs of new materials for each subject title?

    ss.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    ss.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title
  FROM subject_summary ss
)

  sb.subject_title,
  tm.TITLE AS material_title,
  td.ISBN AS isbn,
  SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) OVER (PARTITION BY sb.subject_title) AS total_cost_of_new_materials

  AND tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL

rows.question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fb AS (
  SELECT 
    `BUILDING_NAME_LONG` AS building_name,
    STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(`DATE_BUILT`, ''), '%m/%d/%Y') AS date_built
  FROM `fclt_building`
),
fb_parsed AS (
  SELECT
    building_name,
    date_built,
    YEAR(date_built) AS built_year
  FROM fb
  WHERE date_built IS NOT NULL
),
emp_counts AS (
  -- aggregate a proxy for employees from fac_rooms per building name via fac_building linkage
  SELECT
    fbld.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY, '||', fr.ROOM, '||', fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY)) AS employees
  FROM `fac_rooms` fr
  JOIN `fac_building` fbld
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fbld.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY fbld.BUILDING_NAME_LONG
)
SELECT
  p.building_name AS BUILDING_LONG_NAME,
  p.built_year AS BUILT_YEAR,
  e.employees AS EMPLOYEES
FROM fb_parsed p
LEFT JOIN emp_counts e ON p.building_name = e.building_name
WHERE p.built_year < 1950
  AND COALESCE(e.employees, 0) > 100
ORDER BY p.building_name

rows.question: What is the name of the building that accomodates the most students, and how many students does it accomodate?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH normalized_students_accommodation AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY` AS building_id,
    TRIM(
      REPLACE(
        REPLACE(
          REPLACE(
            REPLACE(
              COALESCE(`BUILDING_NAME`, ''),
              CHAR(9), ' '),
            CHAR(10), ' '),
          CHAR(13), ' '),
        '  ', ' ')
    ) AS building_name_norm,
    -- Prefer explicit BUILDING_COUNTER as the "number of students accommodated" when present,
    -- otherwise fall back to numeric assignable or gross square footage if they look like integers.
    CASE
      WHEN `BUILDING_COUNTER` IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(`BUILDING_COUNTER` AS SIGNED)
      ELSE (
        CASE
          WHEN `BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(`BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS SIGNED)
          WHEN `BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS SIGNED)
          ELSE NULL
        END
      )
    END AS students_accommodated
  FROM `buildings`
),
max_value AS (
  SELECT MAX(students_accommodated) AS max_students_accommodated
  FROM normalized_students_accommodation
)
SELECT
  n.building_name_norm AS building_name,
  CAST(n.students_accommodated AS SIGNED) AS number_of_students_accommodated
FROM normalized_students_accommodation n
JOIN max_value m
  ON n.students_accommodated = m.max_students_accommodated
WHERE n.students_accommodated IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY number_of_students_accommodated DESC

rows.question: List the name and floor of the building with the largest floor number.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH all_floors AS (
  SELECT `FLOOR` FROM `fclt_floor`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT `FLOOR` FROM `fclt_floor_hist`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT `FLOOR` FROM `fac_floor`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT `FLOOR` FROM `space_floor`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT `FLOOR` FROM `fclt_rooms`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT `FLOOR` FROM `fclt_rooms_hist`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT `FLOOR` FROM `fac_rooms`
),
max_floor_cte AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(`FLOOR` AS SIGNED)) AS max_floor
  FROM all_floors
  WHERE `FLOOR` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`FLOOR`) <> ''
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS name,
  f.FLOOR AS floor
FROM fac_floor f
JOIN max_floor_cte m ON CAST(f.FLOOR AS SIGNED) = m.max_floor
LEFT JOIN fclt_building b ON f.BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

WITH parsed_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS session_id,
    s.SESSION_LOCATION AS building,
    sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS detail_session_key,
    sd.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS subject,
    sd.FEE AS fee,
    -- parse start/end times using '%l%M%p' which accepts 1- or 2-digit hour with minutes and am/pm (e.g. '120pm' or '0120pm')
    NULLIF(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '') AS raw_start,
    NULLIF(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '') AS raw_end,
    CASE
      WHEN s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NULL OR s.SESSION_START_TIME = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%l%M%p')
    END AS start_dt,
    CASE
      WHEN s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NULL OR s.SESSION_END_TIME = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%l%M%p')
    END AS end_dt
  FROM iap_subject_session s
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail sd
    ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  -- restrict to sessions that are during IAP by presence of IAP in relevant term or fields.
  -- The schema doesn't have an explicit flag; filter by TERM_CODE in details containing 'IAP' when available.
  WHERE (sd.TERM_CODE IS NULL OR sd.TERM_CODE LIKE '%IAP%') -- keep sessions where detail has IAP or term not present
),
durations AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    building,
    subject,
    fee,
    start_dt,
    end_dt,
    -- only compute duration when both parsed datetimes are not null (i.e., parse succeeded)
    CASE
      WHEN start_dt IS NOT NULL AND end_dt IS NOT NULL THEN
        -- if end_dt <= start_dt treat as next day
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
          MINUTE,
          start_dt,
          CASE WHEN end_dt <= start_dt THEN DATE_ADD(end_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ELSE end_dt END
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS duration_minutes
  FROM parsed_sessions
),
-- aggregate per building
building_agg AS (
  SELECT
    building,
    -- count distinct subjects; use subject title as identifier per requirement
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject) AS total_subjects,
    SUM(fee) AS total_fee,
    -- shortest/longest only among sessions with a computable duration
    MIN(duration_minutes) AS shortest_session,
    MAX(duration_minutes) AS longest_session
  FROM durations
  -- Only include physical locations: non-null, non-empty and not common virtual markers
  WHERE building IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(building) <> ''
    AND LOWER(TRIM(building)) NOT IN ('zoom','virtual','online','remote')
  GROUP BY building
)
SELECT
  building AS building_name,
  total_subjects,
  total_fee,
  shortest_session AS shortest_session_minutes,
  longest_session AS longest_session_minutes
FROM building_agg
ORDER BY total_subjects DESC

WITH
z AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    BUILDING_ROOM,
    SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
    HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
  FROM zpm_rooms_load
),
rooms AS (
  SELECT
    z.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS building_component,
    -- try to get the building name that contains the component: fac_building has BUILDING_NAME and BUILDING_NAME_LONG
    COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, '') AS building_name,
    -- room sqft: prefer space_detail.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, then fclt_rooms.AREA, then fclt_rooms_hist.AREA, else 0
    COALESCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fr.AREA, fch.AREA, 0) AS room_sqft,
    -- floor identifier: prefer textual floor from fclt_rooms, fclt_rooms_hist, fac_floor/fclt_floor via joins if available; fall back to sd.FLOOR_KEY (identifier)
    COALESCE(NULLIF(fr.FLOOR,''), NULLIF(fch.FLOOR,''), sd.FLOOR_KEY, 'UNKNOWN') AS floor_id,
    -- room identifier: prefer canonical room keys where available, else building_room combined with space unit code
    COALESCE(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, fr.BUILDING_ROOM, z.BUILDING_ROOM, CONCAT('ROOM::', COALESCE(z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE,''))) AS room_id
  FROM z
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fb.BUILDING_NAME = z.BUILDING_COMPONENT
    OR fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = z.BUILDING_COMPONENT
  LEFT JOIN space_detail sd
    ON sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT = z.BUILDING_COMPONENT
    AND (sd.BUILDING_ROOM = z.BUILDING_ROOM OR sd.ROOM_NUMBER = z.BUILDING_ROOM OR z.BUILDING_ROOM IS NULL)
  LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr
    ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = z.BUILDING_ROOM
  LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms_hist fch
    ON fch.BUILDING_ROOM = z.BUILDING_ROOM
  -- keep one row per z row; grouping to de-duplicate when joins multiply rows
  GROUP BY
    z.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    z.BUILDING_ROOM,
    z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
    z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    COALESCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fr.AREA, fch.AREA, 0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(fr.FLOOR,''), NULLIF(fch.FLOOR,''), sd.FLOOR_KEY, 'UNKNOWN'),
    COALESCE(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, fr.BUILDING_ROOM, z.BUILDING_ROOM, CONCAT('ROOM::', COALESCE(z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE,'')))
),
-- compute supervisor counts per building component
sup AS (
  SELECT
    z.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS building_component,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.MIT_ID) AS num_supervisors,
    SUM(COALESCE(ss.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES,0)) AS num_supervisees
  FROM z
  LEFT JOIN space_supervisor_usage ss
    ON ss.DEPT_NAMES = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
    OR ss.MIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
  GROUP BY z.BUILDING_COMPONENT
),
-- compute facility organizations per building component by joining fac_organization via space_detail -> ORGANIZATION_KEY when available
fac_orgs AS (
  SELECT
    sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS building_component,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations
  FROM space_detail sd
  LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo
    ON fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
    OR fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
    OR fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
  GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
)
SELECT
  r.building_component AS building_component,
  r.building_name AS building_name,
  -- room square footage per room: one row per room (we include room_sqft in the select so each input room row appears)
  r.room_sqft AS room_square_footage,
  -- total number of floors in the building that contains the component: count distinct floor_id across rooms for that component
  COALESCE(floor_counts.total_number_of_floors, 0) AS total_number_of_floors,
  -- total number of rooms in the component: count distinct room_id for that component
  COALESCE(room_counts.total_number_of_rooms, 0) AS total_number_of_rooms,
  -- total number of facility organizations associated with the component (from fac_orgs); treat missing as 0
  COALESCE(fo.total_facility_organizations, 0) AS total_number_of_facility_organizations,
  -- supervisors and supervisees totals (treat missing as 0)
  COALESCE(s.num_supervisors, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisors,
  COALESCE(s.num_supervisees, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisees
FROM rooms r
LEFT JOIN sup s
  ON s.building_component = r.building_component
LEFT JOIN fac_orgs fo
  ON fo.building_component = r.building_component
-- pre-aggregate counts per building_component for floors and rooms so they are consistent across rows
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    building_component,
    COUNT(DISTINCT floor_id) AS total_number_of_floors
  FROM rooms
  GROUP BY building_component
) AS floor_counts
  ON floor_counts.building_component = r.building_component
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    building_component,
    COUNT(DISTINCT room_id) AS total_number_of_rooms
  FROM rooms
  GROUP BY building_component
) AS room_counts
  ON room_counts.building_component = r.building_component
-- ensure one output row per room within each building component
ORDER BY r.building_component, r.room_id

rows.pred_sql:
WITH dlc_info AS (
  SELECT
    `DLC_KEY` AS dlc_key,
    `DLC_NAME` AS dlc_name
  FROM fclt_organization
  WHERE `DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `DLC_KEY`, `DLC_NAME`
),
building_agg AS (
  SELECT
    fo.`DLC_KEY` AS dlc_key,
    fb.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` AS building_key,
    fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS building_number,
    fb.`BUILDING_NAME` AS building_name,
    GREATEST(
      IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `FLOOR`) FROM fac_floor ff WHERE ff.`BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`),0),
      IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `FLOOR`) FROM fclt_floor ffl WHERE ffl.`BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`),0),
      IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `FLOOR`) FROM fac_rooms fr WHERE fr.`BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`),0),
      IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `FLOOR`) FROM fclt_rooms fr2 WHERE fr2.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`),0)
    ) AS building_floor_count,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(IFNULL(`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`,0)) FROM fac_floor ff2 WHERE ff2.`BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`),
      (SELECT SUM(IFNULL(`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`,0)) FROM fclt_floor ffl2 WHERE ffl2.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`),
      NULL
    ) AS building_assignable_area,
    COALESCE(fb.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`, fb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`, 0) AS building_area_single,
    NULLIF(TRIM(fb.`BUILDING_HEIGHT`), '') AS building_height_raw
  FROM fclt_building fb
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization fo
    ON fo.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD` = fb.`COST_CENTER_CODE`
  WHERE fo.`DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL
),
dlc_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    bi.dlc_key,
    SUM(bi.building_floor_count) AS total_floors,
    SUM(
      GREATEST(
        IFNULL(bi.building_assignable_area,0),
        IFNULL(bi.building_area_single,0)
      )
    ) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bi.building_key) AS buildings_count,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN bi.building_height_raw REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(bi.building_height_raw AS DECIMAL(18,6))
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS total_building_height
  FROM building_agg bi
  GROUP BY bi.dlc_key
),
facility_orgs AS (
  SELECT
    fo.`DLC_KEY` AS dlc_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fo.`FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY`) AS total_facility_organizations
  FROM fclt_organization fo
  WHERE fo.`DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fo.`DLC_KEY`
),
supervise_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.`DLC_KEY` AS dlc_key,
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.`HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL` IS NOT NULL AND h.`HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL` REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' AND CAST(h.`HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL` AS SIGNED) < 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.`HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL` IS NOT NULL AND h.`HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL` REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' AND CAST(h.`HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL` AS SIGNED) >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_supervisees
  FROM hr_org_unit h
  WHERE h.`DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY h.`DLC_KEY`
)
SELECT
  d.dlc_key,
  d.dlc_name,
  COALESCE(dr.total_floors, 0) AS total_floors,
  COALESCE(dr.total_square_footage, 0) AS total_square_footage,
  COALESCE(fo.total_facility_organizations, 0) AS total_facility_organizations,
  COALESCE(sc.total_supervisors, 0) AS total_supervisors,
  COALESCE(sc.total_supervisees, 0) AS total_supervisees,
  COALESCE(dr.total_building_height, 0) AS total_building_height
FROM dlc_info d
LEFT JOIN dlc_rollup dr ON dr.dlc_key = d.dlc_key
LEFT JOIN facility_orgs fo ON fo.dlc_key = d.dlc_key
LEFT JOIN supervise_counts sc ON sc.dlc_key = d.dlc_key
ORDER BY d.dlc_key

  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM IN ('Y','1') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_current,
  COALESCE(tso.num_tip_subject_types, 0) AS total_number_of_distinct_TIP_subject_types_offered,
  -- materials needed: concatenated distinct TIP material titles/authors (or TIP_MATERIAL_KEY if no title)
  COALESCE(tm.materials_needed, '') AS materials_needed_for_TIP_subjects,
  -- min and max enrolled students across subjects in the term; treat NULL as 0
  COALESCE(ts.min_enrolled, 0) AS minimum_number_of_enrolled_students_for_any_subject_in_term,
  COALESCE(ts.max_enrolled, 0) AS maximum_number_of_enrolled_students_for_any_subject_in_term,
  COALESCE(sch.num_schools, 0) AS total_number_of_distinct_schools_offering_subjects_in_term,
  COALESCE(rec.term_record_count, 0) AS total_number_of_records_for_term_code
FROM academic_terms at
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct TIP subject types (use MASTER_SUBJECT_ID as subject type identifier per TIP table)
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subject_types
  FROM tip_subject_offered
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
) tso ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregate/concatenate distinct materials per term. Prefer TITLE||' by '||AUTHOR, fall back to TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  SELECT
    td.TERM_CODE,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(tm.TITLE,'') <> '' THEN CONCAT(tm.TITLE,
          CASE WHEN COALESCE(tm.AUTHOR,'') <> '' THEN CONCAT(' by ', tm.AUTHOR) ELSE '' END)
        ELSE td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
      END
      ORDER BY 1 SEPARATOR '; '
    ) AS materials_needed
  FROM tip_detail td
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE
) tm ON tm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  -- min and max enrolled from subject_offered; treat NULL as 0 via COALESCE
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    MIN(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS min_enrolled,
    MAX(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS max_enrolled
  FROM subject_offered
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
) ts ON ts.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  -- distinct schools offering TIP subjects in the term (use OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME from tip_subject_offered if populated,
  -- otherwise fall back to subject_offered.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME). We'll union both sources to be comprehensive.
  SELECT TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS num_schools
  FROM (
    SELECT TERM_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM tip_subject_offered
    WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME <> ''
    UNION
    SELECT TERM_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM subject_offered
    WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME <> ''
  ) x
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
) sch ON sch.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  -- total number of records (rows) for that term code across the relevant TIP and subject tables
  SELECT TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_record_count
  FROM (
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM tip_subject_offered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM tip_detail
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM subject_offered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM subject_offered_summary
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM subject_summary
  ) u
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
) rec ON rec.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
ORDER BY at.TERM_CODE

    ELSE NULL

      THEN ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(fr.AREA, frh.AREA) / COALESCE(facb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, facb.EXT_GROSS_AREA), 6)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS percent_of_building_area

    -- sum only non-null numeric assignable sqft

      ELSE AVG(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE)
    END AS avg_assignable_sqft,
    -- parse DATE_BUILT from fac_building (we'll join later), but keep placeholder NULL here; actual parsing done in main query

  FROM buildings b
  GROUP BY b.BUILDING_KEY

  CAST(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(fb.DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y') AS UNSIGNED) AS built_year

  LEFT JOIN space_floor sf ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
  -- get one STREET address row if exists: join fclt_building_address on building and ADDRESS_PURPOSE='STREET'
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address fba
    ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
    AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  -- join space_usage for usage description
  LEFT JOIN space_usage su_usage ON su_usage.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
),
-- counts per building+floor: distinct organizations and distinct space units
counts_by_building_floor AS (
  SELECT
    sd.BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(sf.FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS floor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count_same_building_floor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count_same_building_floor
  FROM space_detail sd
  LEFT JOIN space_floor sf ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
  -- attempt to associate rooms to organizations via fclt_rooms using SPACE_ID or ROOM/BUILDING_ROOM
  LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fr
    ON fr.SPACE_ID = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
    OR (fr.ROOM IS NOT NULL AND sd.BUILDING_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND fr.ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM)
  GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_KEY, COALESCE(sf.FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY)
)
SELECT
  u.space_unit_id AS space_unit,
  u.floor,
  u.building_name,
  u.building_street_address AS street_address,
  u.space_usage,
  COALESCE(cbf.org_count_same_building_floor, 0) AS org_count_same_building_floor,
  COALESCE(cbf.space_unit_count_same_building_floor, 0) AS space_unit_count_same_building_floor
FROM units u
LEFT JOIN counts_by_building_floor cbf
  ON cbf.BUILDING_KEY = u.BUILDING_KEY
  AND cbf.floor = u.floor
ORDER BY u.space_unit_id

rows.question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH global_member_count_extremes AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(detail_counts.member_count) AS min_member_count,
    MAX(detail_counts.member_count) AS max_member_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
      COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS member_count
    FROM moira_list_detail d
    JOIN moira_list l ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    WHERE l.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = '1'
    GROUP BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  ) AS detail_counts
),
list_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS member_count
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  GROUP BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
lists_of_interest AS (
  SELECT
    l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    l.IS_PUBLIC,
    l.IS_HIDDEN,
    CASE WHEN l.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = '1' THEN 'MOIRA' ELSE NULL END AS system
  FROM moira_list l
  JOIN list_member_counts lc ON lc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN global_member_count_extremes g ON lc.member_count IN (g.min_member_count, g.max_member_count)
)
SELECT
  li.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  li.IS_PUBLIC AS is_public,
  li.IS_HIDDEN AS is_hidden,
  lc.member_count AS member_count,
  li.system AS system
FROM lists_of_interest li
JOIN list_member_counts lc ON lc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = li.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
-- bring back one row per owner for each list; owner keys come from moira_list_owner joined via owner key present in moira_list_detail
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  FROM moira_list_detail
) AS list_owners ON list_owners.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = li.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN moira_list_owner mlo ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = list_owners.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE lc.member_count IN (
  (SELECT min_member_count FROM global_member_count_extremes),
  (SELECT max_member_count FROM global_member_count_extremes)
)

rows.question: For faculty who are responsible for courses in 2023 fall term, list the name of mailing lists with ten members that they subscribe to, the number of faculty in these lists, and the number of courses associated with those faculty.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH faculty_courses AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS faculty_id,
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS faculty_name,
    so.`TERM_CODE`
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE so.`TERM_CODE` = '2023FA'
    AND so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` <> ''
), 
-- consider moira lists flagged as moira mailing lists
moira_lists AS (
  SELECT
    m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS mailing_list_id,
    m.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS mailing_list_name
  FROM moira_list m
  WHERE COALESCE(m.`IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST`, '') IN ('MOIRA','Y','1')
), 
moira_members AS (
  SELECT
    md.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS mailing_list_id,
    md.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS member_mit_id,
    md.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS member_name
  FROM moira_list_detail md
  WHERE md.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND md.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` <> ''
), 
-- only lists that have exactly 10 distinct members (overall, not restricted yet to faculty responsible for 2023FA)
lists_with_exactly_10_members AS (
  SELECT
    ml.mailing_list_id,
    ml.mailing_list_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mm.member_mit_id) AS mailing_list_member_count
  FROM moira_lists ml
  JOIN moira_members mm ON mm.mailing_list_id = ml.mailing_list_id
  GROUP BY ml.mailing_list_id, ml.mailing_list_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mm.member_mit_id) = 10
), 
-- restrict members to those who are faculty responsible for 2023FA courses
faculty_members_in_lists AS (
  SELECT
    l.mailing_list_id,
    l.mailing_list_name,
    l.mailing_list_member_count,
    mm.member_mit_id AS faculty_id,
    fc.faculty_name
  FROM lists_with_exactly_10_members l
  JOIN moira_members mm ON mm.mailing_list_id = l.mailing_list_id
  JOIN faculty_courses fc ON fc.faculty_id = mm.member_mit_id
), 
-- aggregate faculty per list (only faculty who are both list members and responsible for 2023FA)
faculty_aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    f.mailing_list_id,
    f.mailing_list_name,
    f.mailing_list_member_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.faculty_id) AS faculty_count,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.faculty_id ORDER BY f.faculty_id SEPARATOR ',') AS faculty_ids
  FROM faculty_members_in_lists f
  GROUP BY f.mailing_list_id, f.mailing_list_name, f.mailing_list_member_count
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.faculty_id) > 0
), 
-- count distinct courses in 2023FA for those faculty (distinct by SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_NUMBER, SECTION_ID)
associated_courses AS (
  SELECT
    fa.mailing_list_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS('||', so.SUBJECT_ID, COALESCE(so.COURSE_NUMBER,''), COALESCE(so.SECTION_ID,''))) AS course_count
  FROM faculty_aggregated fa
  JOIN faculty_members_in_lists fml ON fml.mailing_list_id = fa.mailing_list_id
  JOIN subject_offered so
    ON so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` = fml.faculty_id
    AND so.`TERM_CODE` = '2023FA'
  GROUP BY fa.mailing_list_id
)
SELECT
  fa.mailing_list_name AS mailing_list_name,
  fa.faculty_count     AS faculty_count,        -- count of faculty members (from members who are responsible for 2023FA)
  COALESCE(ac.course_count, 0) AS course_count -- distinct courses those faculty are responsible for in 2023FA
FROM faculty_aggregated fa
LEFT JOIN associated_courses ac ON ac.mailing_list_id = fa.mailing_list_id
-- Only include mailing lists where the number of faculty members (from that list who are responsible for 2023FA) equals 10.
-- The requirement states: "Only include mailing lists whose total number of faculty members (from among faculty who are responsible for courses in 2023 fall term and who are members of that mailing list) is exactly 10."
-- Ensure that faculty_count = 10
WHERE fa.faculty_count = 10
ORDER BY fa.mailing_list_name

rows.question: For each course instructor in the 'keeper-zephyr' mailing list, provide the name of mailing lists they subscribe to, instructor name, earliest and latest publication years, and total number of enrolled students.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH kz_members AS (
  SELECT m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
         m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME AS MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  FROM moira_list ml
  JOIN moira_list_detail m ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
),
-- publications: there is no publications table in the schema. Use WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE from course/subject tables as publication proxy if available.
publication_years AS (
  SELECT 
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    MIN(NULLIF(CAST(SUBSTRING(so.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,4) AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(NULLIF(CAST(SUBSTRING(so.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,4) AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS latest_publication_year
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    MIN(NULLIF(CAST(SUBSTRING(ss.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,4) AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(NULLIF(CAST(SUBSTRING(ss.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,4) AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS latest_publication_year
  FROM subject_offered_summary ss
  WHERE ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    ls.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    MIN(NULLIF(CAST(SUBSTRING(ls.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,4) AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(NULLIF(CAST(SUBSTRING(ls.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,4) AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS latest_publication_year
  FROM library_subject_offered ls
  WHERE ls.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ls.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    MIN(NULLIF(CAST(SUBSTRING(ts.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,4) AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(NULLIF(CAST(SUBSTRING(ts.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,4) AS UNSIGNED),0)) AS latest_publication_year
  FROM tip_subject_offered ts
  WHERE ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
),
pub_agg AS (
  -- aggregate across the UNION ALL sets to get per-instructor min/max years (NULL if none)
  SELECT
    MIT_ID,
    MIN(earliest_publication_year) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(latest_publication_year) AS latest_publication_year
  FROM publication_years
  GROUP BY MIT_ID
),
enrollment_by_instructor AS (
  -- sum enrolled students across subject tables for each instructor
  SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
         SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID

  UNION ALL

  SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
         SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM subject_offered_summary
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID

  UNION ALL

  SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
         SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM library_subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID

  UNION ALL

  SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
         SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM tip_subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
),
enroll_agg AS (
  -- combine partial sums
  SELECT MIT_ID, SUM(total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM enrollment_by_instructor
  GROUP BY MIT_ID
)
SELECT
  'keeper-zephyr' AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME, kz.MEMBER_FULL_NAME) AS instructor_name,
  pa.earliest_publication_year,
  pa.latest_publication_year,
  COALESCE(ea.total_enrolled_students, 0) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM kz_members kz
LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed ON ed.MIT_ID = kz.MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN pub_agg pa ON pa.MIT_ID = kz.MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN enroll_agg ea ON ea.MIT_ID = kz.MIT_ID
ORDER BY instructor_name

  FROM `moira_list`
  WHERE `MOIRA_LIST_NAME` = 'beacon-date-date'
),

    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS member_full_name,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME` AS member_full_name_extra,

),
mailing_list_size AS (
  -- size of the beacon list (same value repeated per member)
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`) AS mailing_list_size
  FROM `moira_list_detail`
  WHERE `MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = (SELECT `MOIRA_LIST_KEY` FROM beacon_list)
  GROUP BY `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
),
-- try to extract department phone numbers from available full-name-ish field(s).
-- This is heuristic because schema doesn't include explicit department/phone tables.
member_department_phones AS (
  SELECT
    bm.member_mit_id,
    bm.member_full_name,
    bm.member_full_name_extra,
    bms.mailing_list_size,
    bm.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    -- extract any token that looks like a phone number: digits, spaces, parentheses, + or dashes, length >=7
    TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(
      COALESCE(bm.member_full_name_extra, bm.member_full_name),
      '[0-9\\(\\)\\+\\- ]{7,}'
    )) AS department_phone
  FROM beacon_members bm

)
SELECT
  -- return the student's full name (as available)
  mdp.member_full_name AS student_full_name,
  -- return extracted phone-like token (may be NULL if none found)

  -- repeat mailing list size for each returned student
  COALESCE(mdp.mailing_list_size, 0) AS mailing_list_size
FROM member_department_phones mdp
-- filter students whose family/last name begins with 'H' (case-insensitive).
-- We attempt to match the last token in the plain member_full_name as the last name.
WHERE
  (
    -- if full name contains spaces, take the last token as last name
    LOWER(
      TRIM(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(mdp.member_full_name), ' ', -1)
      )
    )
  ) LIKE 'h%'
ORDER BY mdp.member_full_name

rows.question: For the 'kangaroo-inspire-yearn' email list, for each department present in the list, list the department name, the number of students in that department, and its percentage relative to the students in the mailing list.

WITH list_members AS (
  SELECT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID
  FROM moira_list l
  JOIN moira_list_detail d ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'kangaroo-inspire-yearn'
    AND d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
sis_students AS (
  -- use mit_student_directory to identify students; FULL_NAME is a key in that table but MIT_ID not present,
  -- so join warehouse_users (has MIT_ID) to mit_student_directory by email or name. Prefer joining by EMAIL_ADDRESS.
  SELECT wu.MIT_ID,
         sd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name
  FROM list_members lm
  JOIN warehouse_users wu ON wu.MIT_ID = lm.MIT_ID
  JOIN mit_student_directory sd
    ON (
         (wu.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND sd.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND wu.EMAIL_ADDRESS = sd.EMAIL_ADDRESS)
         OR (wu.FIRST_NAME IS NOT NULL AND wu.LAST_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.FIRST_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.LAST_NAME IS NOT NULL
             AND wu.FIRST_NAME = sd.FIRST_NAME AND wu.LAST_NAME = sd.LAST_NAME)
       )
  -- the join above restricts to rows that appear in the SIS (students)
),
dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(s.department_name, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
    COALESCE(s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS student_count
  FROM sis_students s
  GROUP BY COALESCE(s.department_name, 'Unknown'), COALESCE(s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '')
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM dept_counts
)
SELECT
  dc.department_name AS department_name,
  dc.student_count AS student_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * dc.student_count / NULLIF(tc.total_students, 0), 2) AS percentage_of_list_students
FROM dept_counts dc
CROSS JOIN total_count tc
ORDER BY dc.student_count DESC, dc.department_name

rows.question: For the 'ocean-apple' mailing list, identify the department with the highest student count. WITH subscriptions AS (

    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS person_id,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS member_identifier,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS moira_list_id,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS moira_list_name
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  JOIN moira_list ml
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'ocean-apple'
),

  -- join subscriptions to student directory to restrict to students and carry department info
  SELECT
    s.person_id,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sd.OFFICE_PHONE
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN mit_student_directory sd
    ON ( -- match subscriber to student record; prefer EMAIL_ADDRESS match, fallback to FULL_NAME if needed

rows.question: For each mailing group, list its owner, owner type, the member visibility ('Public Members' if public, and 'Hidden Members' otherwise), and the number of members of this type of visibility. For each owner and owner type, include a grand total for all members in the format of (owner, owner type, null, total members).

WITH member_rows AS (
  SELECT
    o.`OWNER` AS owner,
    o.`OWNER_TYPE` AS owner_type,
    -- derive visibility from moira_list.IS_PUBLIC via the list join; default to 'Hidden Members' when not 'Y'
    CASE WHEN l.`IS_PUBLIC` = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END AS member_visibility,
    d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS member_mit_id
  FROM `moira_list_owner` o
  JOIN `moira_list_detail` d

  JOIN `moira_list` l
    ON l.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = d.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
),

  SELECT
    owner,
    owner_type,
    member_visibility,
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_mit_id) AS member_count
  FROM member_rows
  GROUP BY owner, owner_type, member_visibility
),

  SELECT
    owner,
    owner_type,
    NULL AS member_visibility,
    SUM(member_count) AS member_count
  FROM counts_by_visibility
  GROUP BY owner, owner_type
)
SELECT owner, owner_type, member_visibility, member_count
FROM grand_totals
UNION ALL
SELECT owner, owner_type, member_visibility, member_count
FROM counts_by_visibility
ORDER BY
  owner,
  owner_type,
  CASE WHEN member_visibility IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,

rows.question: Group biology courses by cluster type and course level. For each group, list the name of the department, the course title, cluster type, total enrollments, average enrollment within its cluster, course level, number of unique course materials, average new and used prices for TIP materials, total material record count for TIP materials, number of unique library titles, and number of unique library ISBNs.

SELECT

  COALESCE(s.CLUSTER_TYPE, 'None') AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  -- average enrollment across courses that share the same CLUSTER_TYPE (computed from subject_offered filtered to Biology)
  COALESCE(cluster_avgs.AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER, 0) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER,
  -- derive course level from COURSE_NUMBER or MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER: first leading number sequence (or 'Unknown')
  COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(COALESCE(s.COURSE_NUMBER, s.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER), '^[0-9]+'), ''), 'Unknown') AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(tip_agg.UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIAL_COUNT, 0) AS UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
  COALESCE(tip_agg.AVG_TIP_NEW_PRICE, 0) AS AVG_TIP_NEW_PRICE,
  COALESCE(tip_agg.AVG_TIP_USED_PRICE, 0) AS AVG_TIP_USED_PRICE,
  COALESCE(tip_agg.TOTAL_TIP_MATERIAL_RECORD_COUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_TIP_MATERIAL_RECORD_COUNT,
  COALESCE(lib_agg.UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLE_COUNT, 0) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLE_COUNT,
  COALESCE(lib_agg.UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBN_COUNT, 0) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBN_COUNT
FROM subject_offered s
-- precompute average enrollment per cluster for Biology department
LEFT JOIN (

    AVG(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER
  FROM subject_offered

  GROUP BY COALESCE(CLUSTER_TYPE, 'None')

-- aggregate TIP material info by TERM_CODE + SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    td.TERM_CODE,
    td.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
    AVG(NULLIF(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 0)) AS AVG_TIP_NEW_PRICE,
    AVG(NULLIF(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE, 0)) AS AVG_TIP_USED_PRICE,
    SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0)) AS TOTAL_TIP_MATERIAL_RECORD_COUNT

  ON COALESCE(s.TERM_CODE, '') = COALESCE(tip_agg.TERM_CODE, '')

 AND COALESCE(s.SUBJECT_ID, '') = COALESCE(lib_agg.SUBJECT_ID, '')

  lib_agg.UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLE_COUNT,

rows.question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  so.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(so.SUBJECT_ID, '[0-9]{3,}'), ''),
    NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(so.COURSE_NUMBER, '[0-9]{3,}'), '')
  ) AS course_level,
  so.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units,
  CASE
    WHEN RIGHT(so.TERM_CODE,2) = 'SP' THEN 'Spring'
    WHEN RIGHT(so.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA' THEN 'Fall'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS term_offered,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COALESCE(fall_instructors.count,0) AS fall_instructor_count,
  COALESCE(spring_instructors.count,0) AS spring_instructor_count
FROM subject_offered so
LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    x.SUBJECT_ID,
    LEFT(x.TERM_CODE,4) AS yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(x.instructor_name)) AS count
  FROM (
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor_name FROM cis_course_catalog WHERE FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor_name FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor_name FROM drupal_course_catalog WHERE FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name FROM subject_offered WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name FROM tip_subject_offered WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name FROM library_subject_offered WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      NULL AS SUBJECT_ID,
      NULL AS TERM_CODE,
      NULL AS instructor_name
    WHERE FALSE
  ) x
  WHERE x.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND RIGHT(x.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA'
  GROUP BY x.SUBJECT_ID, LEFT(x.TERM_CODE,4)
) fall_instructors
  ON fall_instructors.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  AND fall_instructors.yr = LEFT(so.TERM_CODE,4)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    x.SUBJECT_ID,
    LEFT(x.TERM_CODE,4) AS yr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(x.instructor_name)) AS count
  FROM (
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor_name FROM cis_course_catalog WHERE SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor_name FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor_name FROM drupal_course_catalog WHERE SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name FROM subject_offered WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name FROM tip_subject_offered WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name FROM library_subject_offered WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      NULL AS SUBJECT_ID,
      NULL AS TERM_CODE,
      NULL AS instructor_name
    WHERE FALSE
  ) x
  WHERE x.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND RIGHT(x.TERM_CODE,2) = 'SP'
  GROUP BY x.SUBJECT_ID, LEFT(x.TERM_CODE,4)
) spring_instructors
  ON spring_instructors.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  AND spring_instructors.yr = LEFT(so.TERM_CODE,4)
WHERE so.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
  AND RIGHT(so.TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','SP')

WITH ps_course_rows AS (
SELECT
  -- course_row_id: use a stable unique id for the course-offering row. Prefer cis_course_catalog.SUBJECT_ID + ':' + SUBJECT_NUMBER + ':' + EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE if available; fall back to drupal_course_catalog.SECTION_ID when cis key parts are NULL.
  CASE
    WHEN `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(`cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID`, ':', `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, ':', `cis_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`)
    ELSE `drupal_course_catalog`.`SECTION_ID`
  END AS course_row_id,

  -- subject_code: SIS subject code comes from sis_subject_code.SUBJECT_CODE
  `sis_subject_code`.`SUBJECT_CODE` AS subject_code,

  -- subject_description: prefer sis_course_description.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG then COURSE_DESCRIPTION
  COALESCE(`sis_course_description`.`COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG`, `sis_course_description`.`COURSE_DESCRIPTION`) AS subject_description,

  -- department_id: department code from sis_subject_code.DEPARTMENT_CODE (joined to ensure accurate department id)
  `sis_subject_code`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS department_id,

  -- department_name: department name from sis_course_description or sis_subject_code (prefer course_description table's department name if present)
  COALESCE(`sis_course_description`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, `sis_subject_code`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS department_name,

  -- is_degree_granting_flag: from sis_course_description.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
  `sis_course_description`.`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` AS is_degree_granting_flag,

  -- course_units: use TOTAL_UNITS from cis_course_catalog when present; otherwise fallback to subject_summary.TOTAL_UNITS
  COALESCE(`cis_course_catalog`.`TOTAL_UNITS`, `subject_summary`.`TOTAL_UNITS`) AS course_units,

  -- enrollment_count: use SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER from subject_summary if present; otherwise try subject_offered_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER; else NULL
  COALESCE(`subject_summary`.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, `subject_offered_summary`.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`) AS enrollment_count,

  -- course_identifier: a human-friendly identifier: prefer cis_course_catalog.SUBJECT_CODE || ' ' || SUBJECT_NUMBER, else subject_summary.SUBJECT_ID || ' ' || subject_summary.SUBJECT_TITLE
  CASE
    WHEN `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(`cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_CODE`, ' ', `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`)
    ELSE CONCAT(`subject_summary`.`SUBJECT_ID`, ' ', COALESCE(`subject_summary`.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, ''))
  END AS course_identifier

FROM `cis_course_catalog`
  -- join to sis_subject_code to get canonical subject and department info
  LEFT JOIN `sis_subject_code`
    ON `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_CODE` = `sis_subject_code`.`SUBJECT_CODE`
       AND (`cis_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = `sis_subject_code`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` OR `sis_subject_code`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NULL)

  -- join to sis_course_description to get descriptions and degree flag; match on course (subject_code + number) and department when possible
  LEFT JOIN `sis_course_description`
    ON (`cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_CODE` = `sis_course_description`.`COURSE` OR CONCAT(`cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_CODE`, ' ', `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`) = `sis_course_description`.`COURSE`)
       OR (`cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID` = `sis_course_description`.`COURSE`)

  -- join to subject_summary to get enrollment and unit totals when cis doesn't have them
  LEFT JOIN `subject_summary`
    ON `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID` = `subject_summary`.`SUBJECT_ID`
       AND (`cis_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = `subject_summary`.`TERM_CODE` OR `subject_summary`.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL)

  -- join to subject_offered_summary as another fallback for enrollment
  LEFT JOIN `subject_offered_summary`
    ON `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID` = `subject_offered_summary`.`SUBJECT_ID`
       AND (`cis_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = `subject_offered_summary`.`TERM_CODE` OR `subject_offered_summary`.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL)

  -- include drupal_course_catalog as a fallback provider of SECTION_ID used for course_row_id if cis key parts are missing
  LEFT JOIN `drupal_course_catalog`
    ON `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID` = `drupal_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID`
       AND (`cis_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = `drupal_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` OR `drupal_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` IS NULL)

WHERE
  -- restrict to Political Science department: department code '17' or department name like '%Political Science%'
  (
    `cis_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = '17'
    OR `cis_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` LIKE '%Political Science%'
    OR `sis_subject_code`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = '17'
    OR `sis_subject_code`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` LIKE '%Political Science%'
    OR `subject_summary`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = '17'
    OR `subject_summary`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` LIKE '%Political Science%'
    OR `drupal_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = '17'
    OR `drupal_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` LIKE '%Political Science%'
  )
),
course_attributes AS (
SELECT
  cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS course_row_id,
  ca.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS attribute_id,
  ca.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS attribute_name,
  ch.`DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN` AS attribute_description,
  ca.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC` AS attribute_category_flag
FROM `cis_course_catalog` cc
JOIN `course_catalog_subject_offered` cso
  ON cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = cso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
JOIN `cis_hass_attribute` ch
  ON ch.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` = cc.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`
-- attribute assignment source: use the course_catalog_subject_offered HASS_ATTRIBUTE as the attribute assignment
JOIN (
  SELECT
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    `HASS_ATTRIBUTE`,
    `HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `HASS_ATTRIBUTE` IS NOT NULL
) ca
  ON ca.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = cso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
WHERE ch.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  course_attributes.attribute_name AS attribute_name,
  course_attributes.attribute_description AS attribute_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps_course_rows.subject_code) AS unique_subjects_count,
  AVG(ps_course_rows.course_units) AS average_units,
  SUM(COALESCE(ps_course_rows.enrollment_count,0)) AS total_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps_course_rows.is_degree_granting_flag = 'Y' THEN ps_course_rows.department_id END) AS departments_granting_degrees_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ps_course_rows.subject_description SEPARATOR '; ') AS subject_code_description
FROM course_attributes
JOIN ps_course_rows USING (course_row_id)
GROUP BY
  course_attributes.attribute_name,
  course_attributes.attribute_description
ORDER BY
  unique_subjects_count DESC,
  attribute_name ASC

rows.question: Group subjects by cluster type, department offering the subject, and the school name. For each group, list the cluster type, name of the department, school name, whether the department grants degrees, total number of subjects, total enrollment, and average enrollment. Exclude clusters or schools with no student data.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(ss.CLUSTER_TYPE, ssel.CLUSTER_TYPE, so.CLUSTER_TYPE) AS cluster_type,
  COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ssel.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS department_name,
  COALESCE(sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ssel.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name,
  COALESCE(sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, 'N') AS department_grants_degrees,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_enrollment,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) = 0 THEN 0
       ELSE ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID), 2)
  END AS average_enrollment
FROM subject_summary ss
LEFT JOIN subject_selector ssel
  ON ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = ssel.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
  AND ss.TERM_CODE = ssel.TERM_CODE
  AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = ssel.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
  ON COALESCE(ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssel.DEPARTMENT_CODE) = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
  ON ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(ss.CLUSTER_TYPE, ssel.CLUSTER_TYPE, so.CLUSTER_TYPE),
  COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ssel.DEPARTMENT_NAME),
  COALESCE(sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ssel.SCHOOL_NAME),
  COALESCE(sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, 'N')
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) > 0

rows.question: For each course, provide the room number of course location, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, room usage, term code, course level, the total number of subjects, unique meeting times, and total units. Do not include meet place or meet times with NULL values.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH rooms AS (
  SELECT
    `ROOM` AS room_number,
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `AREA` AS area,
    `MAJOR_USE_DESC` AS room_usage,
    `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
    `FLOOR_KEY`,
    `ROOM` AS ROOM_KEY
  FROM `fac_rooms`
  WHERE `ROOM` IS NOT NULL
),
buildings_info AS (
  SELECT
    b.`BUILDING_KEY`,
    b.`BUILDING_NAME`,
    b.`BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    ba.`CITY` AS building_city,
    ba.`STATE` AS building_state
  FROM `buildings` b
  LEFT JOIN `fac_building_address` ba
    ON b.`BUILDING_KEY` = ba.`BUILDING_KEY`
),
course_loc AS (
  -- only include rows where MEET_PLACE is not null per requirement, and keep MEET_TIME possibly null
  SELECT
    so.`MEET_PLACE`,
    so.`MEET_TIME`,
    so.`TERM_CODE`,
    so.`MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER`,
    so.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    so.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    so.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    so.`COURSE_NUMBER`,
    so.`COURSE_NUMBER_SORT`,
    so.`SECTION_ID`,
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
  FROM `subject_offered` so
  WHERE so.`MEET_PLACE` IS NOT NULL
),
room_join AS (
  SELECT
    cl.*,
    r.room_number,
    bi.`BUILDING_NAME`,
    bi.`BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    bi.building_city,
    bi.building_state,
    r.area,
    r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    r.room_usage
  FROM course_loc cl
  LEFT JOIN rooms r
    ON cl.`MEET_PLACE` = r.`ROOM_KEY` OR cl.`MEET_PLACE` = r.room_number
  LEFT JOIN buildings_info bi
    ON r.`BUILDING_KEY` = bi.`BUILDING_KEY`
),
group_keys AS (
  -- define a stable course identifier (prefer MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER then SUBJECT_ID)
  SELECT
    rj.*,
    COALESCE(rj.room_number, rj.MEET_PLACE) AS resolved_room,
    COALESCE(rj.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER, rj.SUBJECT_ID) AS course_identifier,
    -- course_level: prefer MASTER_SUBJECT_ID as the "course level" candidate
    rj.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS course_level_candidate
  FROM room_join rj
),
agg_distinct AS (
  -- aggregate per term + course_identifier + resolved_room
  SELECT
    g.TERM_CODE,
    g.course_identifier,
    g.resolved_room,
    MIN(g.room_number) AS room_number,
    MIN(g.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name,
    MIN(g.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS building_number,
    MIN(g.building_city) AS building_city,
    MIN(g.building_state) AS building_state,
    MIN(g.area) AS area,
    MIN(g.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS organization_name,
    MIN(g.room_usage) AS room_usage,
    MIN(g.course_level_candidate) AS course_level,
    -- count of subjects: count distinct non-null SUBJECT_ID across grouped rows
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN g.SUBJECT_ID END) AS total_subjects,
    -- count of unique non-null MEET_TIME per group
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN g.MEET_TIME END) AS unique_meeting_times
  FROM group_keys g
  GROUP BY
    g.TERM_CODE,
    g.course_identifier,
    g.resolved_room
),
units_per_group AS (
  -- sum total units from the available catalog/summary tables for the group,
  -- summing only non-null unit values and matching either SUBJECT_ID or MASTER_SUBJECT_ID to the course_identifier.
  SELECT
    a.TERM_CODE,
    a.course_identifier,
    a.resolved_room,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(ss.`TOTAL_UNITS`)
       FROM `subject_summary` ss
       WHERE ss.`TERM_CODE` = a.TERM_CODE
         AND (ss.`SUBJECT_ID` = a.course_identifier OR ss.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = a.course_identifier)
         AND ss.`TOTAL_UNITS` IS NOT NULL
      ),
      (SELECT SUM(dcc.`TOTAL_UNITS`)
       FROM `drupal_course_catalog` dcc
       WHERE dcc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = a.TERM_CODE
         AND (dcc.`SUBJECT_ID` = a.course_identifier OR dcc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = a.course_identifier)
         AND dcc.`TOTAL_UNITS` IS NOT NULL
      ),
      (SELECT SUM(cc.`TOTAL_UNITS`)
       FROM `cis_course_catalog` cc
       WHERE cc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = a.TERM_CODE
         AND (cc.`SUBJECT_ID` = a.course_identifier OR cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = a.course_identifier)
         AND cc.`TOTAL_UNITS` IS NOT NULL
      )
    ) AS total_units
  FROM agg_distinct a
)
SELECT
  a.room_number AS room_number,
  a.building_name AS building_name,
  a.building_number AS building_number,
  a.building_city AS building_city,
  a.building_state AS building_state,
  a.area AS area,
  a.organization_name AS organization_name,
  a.room_usage AS room_usage,
  a.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  a.course_level AS course_level,
  a.total_subjects AS total_subjects,
  a.unique_meeting_times AS unique_meeting_times,
  COALESCE(u.total_units, 0) AS total_units
FROM agg_distinct a
LEFT JOIN units_per_group u
  ON u.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE
 AND u.course_identifier = a.course_identifier
 AND u.resolved_room = a.resolved_room

rows.question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH valid_catalog AS (
  SELECT
    LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    -- try parse year from CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE; fallback if it's just a year
    CASE
      WHEN CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE,'-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')
      ELSE STR_TO_DATE(CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')
    END AS catalog_create_date
  FROM library_reserve_catalog
  WHERE CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_catalog AS (
  SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  FROM valid_catalog
  WHERE catalog_create_date IS NOT NULL
    AND YEAR(catalog_create_date) >= 2000
),
joined AS (
  /* Join catalog items (filtered by year) to reserve detail (which links to subject/course),
     bring in material status and department info and enrolled students from library_subject_offered. */
  SELECT
    lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    COALESCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS enrolled_students
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
  JOIN filtered_catalog fc ON lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = fc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms ON lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso ON lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
agg AS (
  /* For each material_status + department, count distinct catalog items and sum enrolled students.
     Note: if a catalog item appears multiple times for same status+dept, COUNT(DISTINCT) prevents double-counting catalog items.
     Enrolled students are summed per row as requested (no dedup beyond relationships). */
  SELECT
    COALESCE(material_status, 'Unknown') AS material_status,
    COALESCE(department_name, 'Unknown') AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS number_of_catalog_items,
    SUM(enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY material_status, department_name
),
status_subtotals AS (
  /* Keep the detail rows and add a subtotal per material_status */
  SELECT material_status, department_name, number_of_catalog_items, total_enrolled_students
  FROM agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    material_status,
    'All Departments' AS department_name,
    SUM(number_of_catalog_items) AS number_of_catalog_items,
    SUM(total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY material_status
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS material_status,
    'All Departments' AS department_name,
    SUM(number_of_catalog_items) AS number_of_catalog_items,
    SUM(total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM status_subtotals
  WHERE department_name = 'All Departments'
),
final AS (
  SELECT * FROM status_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
)
SELECT
  material_status,
  department_name,
  number_of_catalog_items,
  total_enrolled_students
FROM final
ORDER BY
  -- order so that for each material_status its departments appear (alphabetical) and then the 'All Departments' subtotal
  CASE WHEN material_status = 'Grand Total' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, -- ensure Grand Total goes last
  material_status,
  -- put subtotal ('All Departments') after department rows by making it sort after other names
  CASE WHEN department_name = 'All Departments' THEN '~~~' ELSE department_name END

rows.question: For each course with enrolled students and with books in the library system, list the name of the department of that course, total number of courses using library materials, the number of catalog items associated with those courses, and the average enrollment per course. Include a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field should be 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH courses_with_library AS (
  SELECT 
    so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(sis.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS department,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.SUBJECT_KEY,
    so.SECTION_ID,
    COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0) AS enrolled,
    lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  FROM subject_offered so
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrd
    ON lrd.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
   AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sis
    ON sis.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  WHERE COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0) > 0
    AND lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
-- aggregate per course (term+subject) to ensure we count each course once and accumulate its catalog items and enrollment
course_level_agg AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    department,
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    MIN(enrolled) AS enrolled, /* enrollment should be same per course; MIN is safe */
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_count_per_course
  FROM courses_with_library
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, department, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID
  HAVING MIN(enrolled) > 0
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 0
),
-- aggregate per department
dept_agg AS (
  SELECT
    department,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials,
    SUM(catalog_count_per_course) AS number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses,
    SUM(enrolled) AS total_enrolled,
    COUNT(*) AS course_count_for_avg
  FROM course_level_agg
  GROUP BY department, DEPARTMENT_CODE
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
),
-- grand total row
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS department,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    SUM(total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials) AS total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials,
    SUM(number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses) AS number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses,
    SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled,
    SUM(course_count_for_avg) AS course_count_for_avg
  FROM dept_agg
)
-- final select: department rows ordered ascending, Grand Total last
SELECT
  department,
  total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials,
  number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN course_count_for_avg = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE total_enrolled / course_count_for_avg
    END
  , 2) AS average_enrollment_per_course
FROM (
  SELECT department,
         total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials,
         number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses,
         total_enrolled,
         course_count_for_avg
  FROM dept_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT department,
         total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials,
         number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses,
         total_enrolled,
         course_count_for_avg
  FROM grand_total
) t
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN department = 'Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  department

rows.question: For each department and school offering courses with materials, list the department name, school name, number of unique course materials, number of courses, average new and used shelf prices of materials, total material records, and number of distinct material statuses. Include a grand total across all schools and departments (the corresponding school and department fields should be null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH tip_courses AS (
  SELECT
    tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'
),
tip_course_materials AS (
  SELECT
    td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    td.RECORD_COUNT
  FROM tip_detail td
  WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    tc.department_name,
    tc.school_name,
    tc.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    tcm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tcm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    tcm.RECORD_COUNT,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE
  FROM tip_courses tc
  JOIN tip_course_materials tcm
    ON tc.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tcm.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tcm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
-- Per department+school aggregates computed directly from material records associated to courses.
agg_by_dept_school AS (
  SELECT
    department_name,
    school_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_unique_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_courses,
    -- AVG should consider only non-null NEW_SHELF_PRICE values across material records
    AVG(CASE WHEN NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN NEW_SHELF_PRICE END) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
    AVG(CASE WHEN USED_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN USED_SHELF_PRICE END) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(RECORD_COUNT, 0)), 0) AS total_material_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS num_distinct_material_statuses
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY department_name, school_name
),
-- Grand totals computed from the base joined rows to ensure correct averages and distinct counts.
grand_base AS (

rows.question: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number, ownership type, organization name, number of rooms, area, and percentage of area relative to the building. Include subtotals across floors, subtotals across all floors for each building, and a grand total across all buildings. For the subtotal for each building and the grand total, the percentage of area should be relative to area of all buildings. All numeric values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators except the relative percentages which should be rounded to two decimal places.

WITH
-- compute grand totals (total number of rooms and total area across all buildings)
grand_totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(COALESCE(NUM_OF_ROOMS,0)) AS total_number_of_rooms,
    SUM(COALESCE(ASSIGNABLE_AREA, EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0)) AS total_area
  FROM fac_building
),
-- per-room rows from fclt_rooms joined to fac_building info
room_rows AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS building_name,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, '') AS floor,
    COALESCE(fr.ROOM, fr.BUILDING_ROOM, '') AS room_number,
    COALESCE(fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, '') AS ownership_type,
    COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') AS organization_name,
    1 AS number_of_rooms,
    COALESCE(fr.AREA, 0) AS area,
    -- sort keys to preserve ordering and to place subtotals correctly
    COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS sort_building,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, '') AS sort_floor,
    COALESCE(fr.ROOM, fr.BUILDING_ROOM, '') AS sort_room
  FROM fclt_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
-- floor subtotals: one row per building + floor
floor_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS building_name,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, '') AS floor,
    '<FLOOR SUBTOTAL>' AS room_number,
    '' AS ownership_type,
    '' AS organization_name,
    SUM(1) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(COALESCE(fr.AREA,0)) AS area,
    COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS sort_building,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, '') AS sort_floor,
    CHAR(127) AS sort_room  -- high-sorting sentinel so subtotal appears after rooms on same floor
  FROM fclt_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, ''), COALESCE(fr.FLOOR, '')
),
-- building subtotals: one row per building summing across floors; use fac_building values for ownership and NUM_OF_ROOMS/areas
building_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME,'') AS building_name,
    '' AS floor,
    '<BUILDING SUBTOTAL>' AS room_number,
    COALESCE(b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,'') AS ownership_type,
    '' AS organization_name,
    COALESCE(b.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 0) AS number_of_rooms,
    COALESCE(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0) AS area,
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME,'') AS sort_building,
    CHAR(127,1) AS sort_floor,  -- ensure building subtotal sorts after floors (use a value greater than any floor)
    CHAR(127) AS sort_room
  FROM fac_building b
),
-- grand total row
grand_total_row AS (
  SELECT
    '__GRAND TOTAL__' AS building_name,
    '' AS floor,
    '<GRAND TOTAL>' AS room_number,
    '' AS ownership_type,
    '' AS organization_name,
    COALESCE(gt.total_number_of_rooms,0) AS number_of_rooms,
    COALESCE(gt.total_area,0) AS area,
    '__GRAND__' AS sort_building,
    CHAR(127,2) AS sort_floor,
    CHAR(127) AS sort_room
  FROM grand_totals gt
),
-- union all detail and subtotal rows
all_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM room_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM floor_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM building_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total_row
)
SELECT
  -- string outputs (NULLs already coalesced in CTEs)
  CAST(ar.building_name AS CHAR) AS Building_Name,
  CAST(ar.floor AS CHAR) AS Floor_Number,
  CAST(ar.room_number AS CHAR) AS Room_Number,
  CAST(ar.ownership_type AS CHAR) AS Ownership_Type,
  CAST(ar.organization_name AS CHAR) AS Organization_Name,
  -- Number of Rooms: round to integer and format with commas
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(ar.number_of_rooms,0)),0) AS Number_of_Rooms,
  -- Area: round to integer and format with commas
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(ar.area,0)),0) AS Area,
  -- Area Percentage: area / grand total area * 100, rounded to 2 decimals and suffixed with %
  CONCAT(
    FORMAT(
      ROUND(
        CASE WHEN gt.total_area = 0 THEN 0
             ELSE (COALESCE(ar.area,0) / gt.total_area) * 100
        END
      , 2)
    , 2)
  , '%') AS Area_Percentage
FROM all_rows ar
CROSS JOIN grand_totals gt
ORDER BY
  -- primary grouping by building name ascending; ensure grand total sorts last
  CASE WHEN ar.room_number = '<GRAND TOTAL>' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
  ar.sort_building ASC,
  -- ensure building subtotal appears after its floors/rooms
  CASE WHEN ar.room_number = '<BUILDING SUBTOTAL>' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ar.sort_floor ASC,
  ar.sort_room ASC

rows.question: For each department, list the name of the department, the title of the TIP material associated with the department, author, ISBN, library term code, and whether it is available in the library reserves ('Available in Library' if yes and 'Not Available in Library' otherwise), the total number of instructors per library book for the department, the total number of materials available in the library for the department, and the total number of available materials across all departments.
