WITH
-- TIP materials joined to TIP detail and subject offering to get department
tip_with_subject AS (
  SELECT
    t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    t.TITLE AS tip_title,
    t.AUTHOR AS author,
    td.ISBN,
    ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    td.TERM_CODE AS library_term_code,
    td.RECORD_COUNT,
    td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  FROM tip_material t
  JOIN tip_detail td ON t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered ts ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
-- Determine availability in library_reserve by matching ISBN or title to library_reserve_catalog and linking through reserve detail where possible.
tip_availability AS (
  SELECT
    tws.*,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
      JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
      WHERE (lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> '' AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN = tws.ISBN)
         OR (lrc.CATALOG_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_TITLE = tws.tip_title)
    ) THEN 'Available in Library' ELSE 'Not Available in Library' END AS library_availability
  FROM tip_with_subject tws
),
-- For instructors per library book for a department:
-- Count distinct instructors linked to a library_reserve_catalog item for that department,
-- and count distinct library_reserve_catalog items for that department.
dept_library_stats AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_library_catalog_items,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS total_distinct_instructors
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lr
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc ON lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci ON lr.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso ON lr.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
),
-- For each department, count distinct TIP materials that have at least one matching library copy (availability).
dept_available_tip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tws.department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tws.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS materials_available_in_library_for_department
  FROM tip_with_subject tws
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
    JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    WHERE (lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> '' AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN = tws.ISBN)
       OR (lrc.CATALOG_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_TITLE = tws.tip_title)
  )
  GROUP BY tws.department_name
),
-- total available materials across all departments (count of TIP materials that have at least one library copy)
total_available_overall AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tws.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_available_materials_across_all_departments
  FROM tip_with_subject tws
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
    JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    WHERE (lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN <> '' AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN = tws.ISBN)
       OR (lrc.CATALOG_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_TITLE = tws.tip_title)
  )
)
SELECT

  tav.tip_title AS tip_title,
  tav.author AS author,
  tav.ISBN AS isbn,
  tav.library_term_code AS library_term_code,
  tav.library_availability AS library_availability,
  -- instructors_per_library_book: distinct instructors / distinct library catalog items for the department (0 if no catalog items)
  CASE

    ELSE ROUND(dls.total_distinct_instructors / dls.total_library_catalog_items, 4)

FROM tip_availability tav

  ON tav.department_name = dls.department_name

  ON tav.department_name = dac.department_name
CROSS JOIN total_available_overall tao

          DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(TRIM(ss.SESSION_START_TIME), '%H:%i:%s'), '%H:%i:%s'),
          TRIM(ss.SESSION_START_TIME)
        )
    END AS session_start_time_normalized
  FROM subject_iap_schedule s
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_session ss
    ON s.SESSION_NUMBER = ss.SESSION_SEQUENCE
    AND s.SUBJECT_ID = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail d
    ON s.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE
    AND s.SUBJECT_ID = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_sponsor sp
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
),
category_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sln.session_id) AS unique_sessions,
    SUM(COALESCE(sln.attendees_count_normalized,0)) AS total_attendees,
    CONCAT(MIN(sln.term_code), '-', MAX(sln.term_code)) AS active_period
  FROM iap_subject_category c
  LEFT JOIN session_level_normalized sln
    ON sln.iap_category_id = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
),
most_common_per_category AS (
  SELECT
    ca.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    -- most common sponsor
    (
      SELECT sponsor_name_normalized
      FROM (
        SELECT sponsor_name_normalized, COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM session_level_normalized s2
        WHERE s2.iap_category_id = ca.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
          AND s2.sponsor_name_normalized IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY sponsor_name_normalized
        ORDER BY cnt DESC, sponsor_name_normalized ASC
        LIMIT 1
      ) AS inner_s
    ) AS most_common_sponsor,
    -- most common start time
    (
      SELECT session_start_time_normalized
      FROM (
        SELECT session_start_time_normalized, COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM session_level_normalized s3
        WHERE s3.iap_category_id = ca.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
          AND s3.session_start_time_normalized IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY session_start_time_normalized
        ORDER BY cnt DESC, session_start_time_normalized ASC
        LIMIT 1
      ) AS inner_t
    ) AS most_common_start_time
  FROM category_aggregates ca
)
SELECT
  ca.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  ca.unique_sessions,
  ca.total_attendees,
  ca.active_period,
  m.most_common_sponsor,
  m.most_common_start_time
FROM category_aggregates ca
LEFT JOIN most_common_per_category m
  ON m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = ca.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS category_name,
  SUM(unique_sessions) AS unique_sessions,
  SUM(total_attendees) AS total_attendees,
  NULL AS active_period,
  NULL AS most_common_sponsor,
  NULL AS most_common_start_time
FROM category_aggregates

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN category_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  category_name

rows.question: For each building type, list the name of the building type, the number of buildings that are not subdivisions, number of employees, number of unique building street address, number of unique city, number of unique state, number of unique postal code, and average gross square footage per employee. For building type of 'resident', display it as 'RESIDENTIAL'. Include a grand total across all building types (the corresponding type field is 'TOTAL').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(`BUILDING_TYPE`), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS building_type,
    `BUILDING_KEY` AS building_key,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`,
    COALESCE(`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`, 0) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM buildings
),
fb_combined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(`BUILDING_TYPE`), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS building_type,
    `FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS building_key,
    `PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER`
  FROM fac_building
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(`BUILDING_TYPE`), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS building_type,
    `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` AS building_key,
    `PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER`
  FROM fclt_building
),
non_sub AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    building_type,
    building_key,
    CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, '')) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_non_subdivision
  FROM fb_combined
),
emps AS (
  -- fac_rooms.BUILDING_KEY stores the fac_building key; join fac_building on FAC_BUILDING_KEY to get BUILDING_TYPE
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(fb.BUILDING_TYPE), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS building_type,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    COUNT(*) AS employees
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(fb.BUILDING_TYPE), ''), 'UNKNOWN'), fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
addr AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(fb.BUILDING_TYPE), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS building_type,
    fba.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba.STREET_NUMBER, '')) AS street_number,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba.STREET_NAME, '')) AS street_name,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba.CITY, '')) AS city,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba.STATE, '')) AS state,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba.POSTAL_CODE, '')) AS postal_code
  FROM fac_building_address fba
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(fb2.BUILDING_TYPE), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS building_type,
    fba2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    fba2.ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba2.STREET_NUMBER, '')) AS street_number,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba2.STREET_NAME, '')) AS street_name,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba2.CITY, '')) AS city,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba2.STATE, '')) AS state,
    TRIM(COALESCE(fba2.POSTAL_CODE, '')) AS postal_code
  FROM fclt_building_address fba2
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb2 ON fb2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
per_building AS (
  -- union keys from buildings and fac/fclt combined to ensure coverage
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(b.building_type), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS building_type,
    b.building_key,
    COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS gross_sqft
  FROM b
  UNION
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(fb.building_type), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS building_type,
    fb.building_key,
    0 AS gross_sqft
  FROM fb_combined fb
),
per_building_with_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    pb.building_key,
    pb.building_type,
    COALESCE(pb.gross_sqft, 0) AS gross_sqft,
    COALESCE(SUM(e.employees), 0) AS employees,
    -- street address counted only when ADDRESS_PURPOSE='STREET' and both street_number and street_name present
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' AND a.street_number <> '' AND a.street_name <> '' THEN CONCAT(a.street_number, ' ', a.street_name) ELSE NULL END) AS street_address,
    MAX(NULLIF(a.city, '')) AS city,
    MAX(NULLIF(a.state, '')) AS state,
    MAX(NULLIF(a.postal_code, '')) AS postal_code,
    COALESCE(MAX(n.is_non_subdivision), 0) AS is_non_subdivision
  FROM per_building pb
  LEFT JOIN addr a ON a.building_key = pb.building_key
  LEFT JOIN emps e ON e.building_key = pb.building_key
  LEFT JOIN non_sub n ON n.building_key = pb.building_key
  GROUP BY pb.building_key, pb.building_type, pb.gross_sqft
),
agg_by_type AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN building_type = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE building_type END AS building_type,
    SUM(is_non_subdivision) AS non_subdivision_building_count,
    SUM(employees) AS employees,
    COUNT(DISTINCT street_address) AS unique_street_address_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS unique_city_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS unique_state_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT postal_code) AS unique_postal_code_count,
    CASE WHEN SUM(employees) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(gross_sqft) / SUM(employees) END AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
  FROM per_building_with_metrics
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN building_type = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE building_type END
)
SELECT
  'building_type,non_subdivision_building_count,employees,unique_street_address_count,unique_city_count,unique_state_count,unique_postal_code_count,avg_gross_sqft_per_employee'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CONCAT_WS(',',
    building_type,
    CAST(non_subdivision_building_count AS CHAR),
    CAST(employees AS CHAR),
    CAST(unique_street_address_count AS CHAR),
    CAST(unique_city_count AS CHAR),
    CAST(unique_state_count AS CHAR),
    CAST(unique_postal_code_count AS CHAR),
    IFNULL(CAST(ROUND(avg_gross_sqft_per_employee, 2) AS CHAR), '')
  )
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM agg_by_type
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS building_type,
    SUM(non_subdivision_building_count),
    SUM(employees),
    SUM(unique_street_address_count),
    SUM(unique_city_count),
    SUM(unique_state_count),
    SUM(unique_postal_code_count),
    CASE WHEN SUM(employees) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(avg_gross_sqft_per_employee * employees) / SUM(employees) END
  FROM agg_by_type
) t

rows.question: List each organization's break group, ID, name, and formatted name according to its level, along with whether its members are emeritus or non-emeritus. rows.question: For each course, list its title, name of the building of the course location, duration (in terms of days), and a running average of the duration (in terms of days) using a window of two preceding and two following courses (partitioned by academic year and sorted by course start date).
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS title,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  -- compute duration in days between FROM_TERM (start) and THRU_TERM (end)
  DATEDIFF(
    STR_TO_DATE(si.THRU_TERM, '%Y%m%d'),
    STR_TO_DATE(si.FROM_TERM, '%Y%m%d')
  ) AS duration_in_days,
  -- running average over window of 2 preceding and 2 following, partitioned by academic year and ordered by start date
  ROUND(
    AVG(
      DATEDIFF(
        STR_TO_DATE(si.THRU_TERM, '%Y%m%d'),
        STR_TO_DATE(si.FROM_TERM, '%Y%m%d')
      )
    ) OVER (
      PARTITION BY si.FROM_TERM -- corrected below to partition by academic year; see note
      ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(si.FROM_TERM, '%Y%m%d')
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ), 2
  ) AS running_avg_duration_window_2_prev_2_next
FROM subject_offered so
LEFT JOIN sis_course_description si
  ON si.COURSE = CONCAT(so.SUBJECT_ID, ' ', so.COURSE_NUMBER)
LEFT JOIN space_detail sd
  ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE si.FROM_TERM IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY si.FROM_TERM, STR_TO_DATE(si.FROM_TERM, '%Y%m%d'), so.SUBJECT_TITLE

rows.question: For each course, list its name, name of the building of the course location, the start date, the name of the course before it, and the name of the course after it, access level of the building, and the assignable area of the room used for the course, sorted by the ascending order start date and course name.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH courses AS (
  SELECT
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
    l.TERM_CODE,
    -- get earliest IAP_DATE for the course instance; parse to DATE. If no valid date, will be NULL.
    MIN(STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(i.IAP_DATE, ''), '%Y-%m-%d')) AS start_date,
    l.SUBJECT_ID,
    l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    l.COURSE_NUMBER,
    CONCAT(l.TERM_CODE, '-', l.SUBJECT_ID, '-', COALESCE(l.COURSE_NUMBER, '')) AS course_instance_id,
    l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  FROM library_subject_offered l
  LEFT JOIN subject_iap_schedule i
    ON l.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE
   AND l.SUBJECT_ID = i.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN subject_enrollable s
    ON l.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
   AND l.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, l.COURSE_NUMBER
),
room_assign AS (
  -- map the course offering to a room/building from zpm_rooms_load using common keys
  SELECT
    l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    l.SUBJECT_ID,
    z.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS building_name,
    z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
    z.ACCESS_LEVEL AS building_access_level,
    z.BUILDING_ROOM,
    z.FLOOR
  FROM library_subject_offered l
  JOIN zpm_rooms_load z
    ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
    OR l.SUBJECT_ID = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
    OR l.COURSE_NUMBER = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
  -- use INNER JOIN because required building/room must exist per spec
),
room_area AS (
  -- room assignable area coming from space_detail (ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE)
  SELECT
    sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
    sd.BUILDING_KEY,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY,
    sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS room_assignable_area,
    sd.BUILDING_ROOM
  FROM space_detail sd
),
course_locations AS (
  SELECT
    c.course_name,
    c.start_date,
    r.building_name,
    r.building_access_level,
    ra.room_assignable_area,
    c.course_instance_id,
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  FROM courses c
  JOIN room_assign r
    ON c.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = r.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  -- join to room_area by SPACE_UNIT_KEY = SPACE_UNIT_CODE when available, else by BUILDING_ROOM match
  LEFT JOIN room_area ra
    ON (ra.SPACE_UNIT_KEY IS NOT NULL AND ra.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE)
    OR (ra.BUILDING_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND r.BUILDING_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND ra.BUILDING_ROOM = r.BUILDING_ROOM)
  -- we keep LEFT JOIN to room_area because if no matching space_detail the course should be excluded per spec;
  -- however earlier join to zpm_rooms_load is forced (INNER) so courses without room/building are already excluded.
),
with_prev_next AS (
  SELECT
    cl.*,
    LAG(cl.course_name) OVER (PARTITION BY cl.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cl.start_date, cl.course_name) AS previous_course,
    LEAD(cl.course_name) OVER (PARTITION BY cl.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cl.start_date, cl.course_name) AS next_course
  FROM course_locations cl
)
SELECT
  -- per spec: allow NULL when no prev/next; output course/building/start_date/access/area; exclude rows missing building or room assignable area
  with_prev_next.course_name AS course_name,
  with_prev_next.building_name AS building_name,
  -- format start_date as YYYY-MM-DD if present
  CASE WHEN with_prev_next.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(with_prev_next.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END AS start_date,
  with_prev_next.previous_course AS previous_course,
  with_prev_next.next_course AS next_course,
  with_prev_next.building_access_level AS building_access_level,
  with_prev_next.room_assignable_area AS room_assignable_area
FROM with_prev_next
WHERE with_prev_next.building_name IS NOT NULL
  AND with_prev_next.room_assignable_area IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY with_prev_next.start_date ASC, with_prev_next.course_name ASC

rows.question: For email lists with names starting with e (case insensitive), containing 10 to 20 members inclusive, and where over 75% are computer science students, provide the list name, owner, and member count.

rows.question: For students with last names starting with K, list their names, the phone numbers of departments they belong to, total number of mailing lists each student is in, and the average size of the mailing lists each student is in.

WITH students_with_lastname_k AS (
  SELECT
    msd.FULL_NAME AS student_id, -- key to identify student in this directory (no MIT_ID available here)
    msd.FIRST_NAME,
    msd.LAST_NAME,
    msd.FULL_NAME AS full_name,
    msd.DEPARTMENT
  FROM `mit_student_directory` msd
  WHERE msd.LAST_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND LEFT(msd.LAST_NAME, 1) = 'K'
),
-- compute sizes (member counts) per MOIRA list based on moira_list_detail
list_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`) AS size
  FROM `moira_list_detail` mld
  GROUP BY mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
),
-- For each member MIT_ID, count distinct MOIRA lists they are on and average the sizes of those lists.
-- Join to moira_list to restrict to lists that are MOIRA-managed.
student_list_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS member_mit_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`) AS total_lists,

  WHERE ml.`IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST` IN ('Y','1') -- treat these as MOIRA-managed lists
  GROUP BY mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`

                        ORDER BY CONCAT_WS('', sd.`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE`, sd.`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`) SEPARATOR ',')
    FROM `student_department` d
    LEFT JOIN `sis_admin_department` sd
      ON d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = sd.`SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE`
    WHERE d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = s.DEPARTMENT
  ) AS department_phone_numbers,
  -- total distinct mailing lists the student is a member of.

  -- average mailing-list size across lists the student is a member of; NULL if none (per requirement prefer NULL when count is 0).
  sla.avg_list_size AS average_mailing_list_size
FROM students_with_lastname_k s

  ON sla.member_mit_id = s.student_id

-- moira_list_detail has MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID (preferred) and MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER (free text).
members_with_dept AS (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') AS member_mit_id,
    -- attempt to associate to mit_student_directory by FULL_NAME match first, then by MEMBER text
    ms.DEPARTMENT AS sis_dept_code,
    ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sis_dept_name
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  LEFT JOIN mit_student_directory ms
    ON (NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') = NULLIF(ms.FULL_NAME, ''))
       OR (NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NULL AND NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '') = NULLIF(ms.FULL_NAME, ''))
),
-- count students per list and department (only rows that matched an SIS student record are considered students)
dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    mw.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(mw.sis_dept_code, ''), NULLIF(mw.sis_dept_name, '')) AS dept_identifier,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(mw.sis_dept_name, ''), NULLIF(mw.sis_dept_code, '')) AS dept_name,
    COUNT(*) AS students_in_dept
  FROM members_with_dept mw
  WHERE mw.sis_dept_code IS NOT NULL OR mw.sis_dept_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mw.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, dept_identifier, dept_name
),
-- pick the top department per list (deterministic tie-breaker by dept_identifier)
top_dept_per_list AS (
  SELECT
    dc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    dc.dept_identifier,
    dc.dept_name,
    dc.students_in_dept,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY ORDER BY dc.students_in_dept DESC, dc.dept_identifier) AS rn
  FROM dept_counts dc
),
top100_lists AS (
  SELECT
    lmc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    lmc.is_public,
    lmc.total_subscribers
  FROM list_member_counts lmc
  ORDER BY lmc.total_subscribers DESC, lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  LIMIT 100
)
SELECT
  t.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  t.total_subscribers AS total_subscribers,
  t.is_public AS public_status,
  COALESCE(td.dept_name, '(no student department)') AS top_department_name,
  COALESCE(td.students_in_dept, 0) AS students_from_top_department
FROM top100_lists t
LEFT JOIN top_dept_per_list td
  ON t.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = td.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AND td.rn = 1
ORDER BY t.total_subscribers DESC, t.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For each department, list its name, number of unique courses offered, the number of unique reserved materials, and the number of unique instructors associated with those courses, sorted by the number of unique courses offered in descending order.

WITH dept_course_counts AS (
  -- count distinct courses (by SUBJECT_ID) per department from multiple course sources
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccsd.SUBJECT_TITLE, '') AS department_name,
    all_courses.dept_code AS department_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT all_courses.subject_id) AS unique_courses
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id
    FROM subject_offered
    WHERE OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> ''
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE AS dept_code, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> ''
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE AS dept_code, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> ''
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE AS dept_code, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id
    FROM cis_course_catalog
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> ''
  ) AS all_courses
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd ON all_courses.dept_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_department ccsd ON all_courses.dept_code = ccsd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY all_courses.dept_code, department_name
),
dept_reserved_materials AS (
  -- count distinct reserved materials (by CATALOG_ISBN or CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER if ISBN blank) for courses offered by dept
  SELECT
    COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccsd.SUBJECT_TITLE, '') AS department_name,
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS department_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      NULLIF(
        COALESCE(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN, lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER),
        ''
      )
    ) AS unique_reserved_materials
  FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_department ccsd ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ccsd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> ''
  GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, department_name
),
dept_instructors AS (
  -- count distinct instructors associated with a department's courses.
  -- Use RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID from subject_offered and RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID from library_subject_offered and library_course_instructor (mapped to dept via UNIT_CODE)
  -- Normalize instructor identifier: prefer MIT id, fallback to name.
  SELECT
    COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccsd.SUBJECT_TITLE, '') AS department_name,
    dept_code AS department_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(instr_id, '')) AS unique_instructors
  FROM (
    -- instructors from subject_offered (dept = OFFER_DEPT_CODE)
    SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS instr_id
    FROM subject_offered
    WHERE OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> '' AND RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> ''
    UNION
    -- instructors from library_subject_offered (dept = OFFER_DEPT_CODE)
    SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS instr_id
    FROM library_subject_offered
    WHERE OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> '' AND RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> ''
    UNION
    -- instructors from library_course_instructor (dept = UNIT_CODE), use INSTRUCTOR_NAME when MIT id not available
    SELECT DISTINCT UNIT_CODE AS dept_code, COALESCE(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, '') AS instr_id
    FROM library_course_instructor lci
    WHERE UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND UNIT_CODE <> '' AND (lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME <> '')
  ) AS combined
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd ON combined.dept_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_department ccsd ON combined.dept_code = ccsd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY dept_code, department_name
),
all_departments AS (
  -- union of all department ids encountered in any of the measures
  SELECT department_id, department_name FROM (
    SELECT department_id, department_name FROM dept_course_counts
    UNION
    SELECT department_id, department_name FROM dept_reserved_materials
    UNION
    SELECT department_id, department_name FROM dept_instructors
  ) t
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(ad.department_name, '') AS department_name,
  COALESCE(ad.department_id, '') AS department_id,
  COALESCE(dcc.unique_courses, 0) AS unique_courses,
  COALESCE(drm.unique_reserved_materials, 0) AS unique_reserved_materials,
  COALESCE(din.unique_instructors, 0) AS unique_instructors
FROM all_departments ad
LEFT JOIN dept_course_counts dcc ON ad.department_id = dcc.department_id
LEFT JOIN dept_reserved_materials drm ON ad.department_id = drm.department_id
LEFT JOIN dept_instructors din ON ad.department_id = din.department_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(dcc.unique_courses, 0) DESC

rows.question: List the names of the buildings with the most floors. If there are ties, list each one separately.

-- Return the BUILDING_NAME(s) of buildings that have the maximum number of distinct floors.
-- The schema does not include a direct "floor count" column per building, so compute number of distinct FLOOR values
-- from fac_floor (per-building floor rows) and from fclt_floor (alternate source). Union them per building,
-- count distinct floors per building, find the overall max, and return BUILDING_NAME from buildings (or fac_building/fclt_building if needed).
WITH floors_per_building AS (
  -- floors from fac_floor (uses BUILDING_KEY)
  SELECT
    ff.BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FLOOR) AS floor_count
  FROM fac_floor ff
  WHERE ff.FLOOR IS NOT NULL AND ff.FLOOR <> ''
  GROUP BY ff.BUILDING_KEY

  UNION ALL

  -- floors from fclt_floor (uses FCLT_BUILDING_KEY -> join to fclt_building to get BUILDING_KEY if available)
  SELECT
    fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ffl.FLOOR) AS floor_count
  FROM fclt_floor ffl
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb ON ffl.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE ffl.FLOOR IS NOT NULL AND ffl.FLOOR <> ''
  GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
combined_floor_counts AS (
  -- Aggregate counts from both sources per building_key (some keys may be null; ignore those)
  SELECT
    building_key,
    SUM(floor_count) AS total_floors
  FROM floors_per_building
  WHERE building_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY building_key
),
max_floor_value AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_floors) AS max_floors FROM combined_floor_counts
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fcb.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name
FROM combined_floor_counts c
CROSS JOIN max_floor_value m
LEFT JOIN buildings b ON c.building_key = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON c.building_key = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fcb ON c.building_key = fcb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE c.total_floors = m.max_floors
ORDER BY building_name

WITH course_identity_normalized AS (
SELECT
  -- canonical_course_id: normalized canonical identifier for a course
  -- build from MASTER_SUBJECT_ID + COURSE_NUMBER where available, trim and upper-case to canonicalize
  TRIM(UPPER(
    COALESCE(NULLIF(`subject_offered`.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, ''), NULLIF(`cis_course_catalog`.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, ''), NULLIF(`drupal_course_catalog`.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, ''))
    || ' ' ||
    COALESCE(NULLIF(`subject_offered`.`COURSE_NUMBER`, ''), NULLIF(`subject_offered_summary`.`COURSE_NUMBER`, ''), NULLIF(`tip_subject_offered`.`COURSE_NUMBER`, ''), NULLIF(`sis_course_description`.`COURSE`, ''), '')
  )) AS canonical_course_id,

  -- school_id: prefer explicit school code where available; fall back to department_code where appropriate
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(`subject_selector`.`SCHOOL_CODE`, ''),
    NULLIF(`sis_subject_code`.`SCHOOL_CODE`, ''),
    NULLIF(`sis_course_description`.`DEPARTMENT`, ''),
    NULLIF(`cis_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, ''),
    NULLIF(`subject_summary`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, '')
  ) AS school_id,

  -- is_degree_granting: preserve stored degree-granting flag from sis_course_description if present
  NULLIF(`sis_course_description`.`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`, '') AS is_degree_granting
FROM `subject_offered`
  -- join to various catalog sources to ensure original stored columns are available when present
  LEFT JOIN `subject_offered_summary`
    ON `subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` = `subject_offered_summary`.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `tip_subject_offered`
    ON `subject_offered`.`MASTER_SUBJECT_KEY` = `tip_subject_offered`.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
      AND `subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` = `tip_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE`
  LEFT JOIN `subject_summary`
    ON `subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY` = `subject_summary`.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `subject_selector`
    ON `subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY` = `subject_selector`.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`
      AND `subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` = `subject_selector`.`TERM_CODE`
  LEFT JOIN `sis_subject_code`
    ON `subject_offered`.`COURSE_NUMBER` = `sis_subject_code`.`COURSE_NUMBER`

WITH departments_union AS (

  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_id, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, NULL AS phone_area, NULL AS phone_number
  FROM sis_department
  UNION
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_id, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, NULL AS phone_area, NULL AS phone_number
  FROM student_department
  UNION
  SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_id, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE AS phone_area, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS phone_number
  FROM sis_admin_department
),
departments_sel AS (
  -- collapse duplicates, prefer names/phones from sis_department/student_department then sis_admin_department phone if present
  SELECT
    du.department_id,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM sis_department sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.department_id LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM student_department sd2 WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.department_id LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT sa.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM sis_admin_department sa WHERE sa.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.department_id LIMIT 1)
    ) AS department_name,
    -- construct phone from sis_admin_department if present
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT CONCAT(
         NULLIF(sa.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, ''),
         CASE
           WHEN sa.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sa.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE <> '' AND sa.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND sa.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER <> ''
           THEN CONCAT('-', sa.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER)
           ELSE COALESCE(sa.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, '')
         END
       ) FROM sis_admin_department sa WHERE sa.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.department_id LIMIT 1),
      NULL
    ) AS department_phone
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT department_id FROM departments_union
  ) du
),
dept_student_aggregates AS (
  -- aggregate students from mit_student_directory by department code
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_id,
    COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count,
    COALESCE(MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(msd.FULL_NAME, ''), ''))), 0) AS max_full_name_length
  FROM (
    -- ensure we consider every department present in department tables for grouping
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM sis_department
    UNION
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_department
    UNION
    SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM sis_admin_department
  ) d
  LEFT JOIN mit_student_directory msd
    ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT

  ds.department_phone AS department_phone,
  COALESCE(dsa.student_count, 0) AS number_of_students,
  COALESCE(dsa.max_full_name_length, 0) AS longest_student_full_name_length
